fee_notes: Base fee is $49,000. Discounts available: $9,000 per additional agreement purchased simultaneously; 50% discount for approved expansion after 2 years; reduced fees for rural/secondary markets or conversions. Veteran and First Responder discount: $10,000 off. Most recent fiscal year range: $40,000-$49,000 (low for multi-unit, high for single territory).
raw_excerpt: On the date you sign the Franchise Agreement, you must pay an Initial Franchise Fee to the Company of $49,000. In our most recent fiscal year, Franchisees paid Initial Franchise Fees ranging between $40,000 and $49,000. The low end was for the purchase of a second territory at the same time as the first, and the high end was the standard fee for a new territory.
